context: Extend the existing canonical package implementation and release workflow. Do not add BenchBox code, copy tracker logic into another repository, or inspect/modify credentials. Confirm the exact published version and artifact hash before downstream adoption.
description: Release the canonical todo-db package containing the holder-only claim-release semantics required by BenchBox. Start from the existing fix/release-holder-only implementation and its tracker/CLI regression tests. Publish the next unused patch version after 0.3.0 as an immutable artifact; BenchBox must consume the released package, never a sibling checkout, mutable branch, or copied implementation. This is a prerequisite for the hosted schema migration and the embedded-runtime replacement.

anti_patterns.dont: Patch BenchBox's embedded release_item as the permanent solution
anti_patterns.instead: Fix and release the canonical todo-db package, then cut BenchBox over to it
anti_patterns.why: That would preserve the duplicate implementation this batch is intended to remove

anti_patterns.dont: Read, copy, or commit database credentials
anti_patterns.instead: Use approved environment-provided authority only during authorized live gates
anti_patterns.why: Credentials are runtime-only and must not enter source or tracker artifacts

anti_patterns.dont: Use a sibling checkout, mutable branch, or local path dependency for the production runtime
anti_patterns.instead: Pin the released package in BenchBox's uv project and lock
anti_patterns.why: Fresh clones and CI would not reproduce the same tracker implementation

preserves.behavior: non-holder release fails with exit 2 and preserves the holder claim
release artifacts are built and installed from an immutable published version
todo-db remains the sole owner of generic lifecycle, schema, backend, CLI, audit, export, and claim semantics
unclaimed release remains an idempotent no-op

verifications.command: uv run pytest tests/test_packaging_smoke.py -q && uv build
verifications.description: Wheel and sdist build and isolated packaging smoke pass
